title: Final Answer for (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The mean collision time tau must be correctly calculated and presented.

title: Final Answer for (b)
description: Essential Criteria: The electron number density n must be correctly calculated and presented.

title: Mean Free Path Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of the mean free path l must be shown and correctly derived.

title: Average Velocity Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of the average velocity v must be shown and correctly derived.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: All units must be consistent and correctly applied throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors in (a)
description: Pitfall Criteria: Missing factors or incorrect assumptions in the calculation of tau will lead to significant errors.

title: Common Errors in (b)
description: Pitfall Criteria: Errors in the integration limits or incorrect application of the Fermi momentum will lead to incorrect results.
